messages:
Lucy: Quick planning thread
Concord PM: We want a joint integration announcement for our Gateway + Redwood LlamaIndex adapter. Target mid-Sept. Can we align?
Maria: We own the marketplace tile and pricing blurb. Need logos and a 1-line summary from Concord.
Sanjay: Eng can deliver a verified sample adapter and a tiny demo app. Blocker: SSO creds and final API contract.
Andrew: DevEx will make quickstart + demo script. Please send sample payloads and a curl example.
Lucy: Timeline check: embargo date, rehearsal slot, who submits marketplace listing?
Concord PM: Embargo: 2024-09-16. We will provide logo package and approve messaging. No customer quotes.
Sanjay: For claims about "works out of the box" we need a short compatibility matrix and perf caveats for quantized models.
Maria: Noted. I prefer to reference our curated llama-13b-quant profile and call out alternatives.
Andrew: Sample curl we plan to ship: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"adapter":"concord","input":"Summarize"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/concord-gateway-2024-09 (2x GPUs, retention 72h).
integrations-bot: Added board items: SSO metadata, adapter contract, quickstart draft, marketplace copy, legal review.
Eve (Legal): Send joint messaging and any performance numbers. I will review assets and marketplace text.
Lucy: Action owners: Maria = marketplace copy + submit; Sanjay = adapter + compatibility doc; Andrew = quickstart + demo; Eve = legal sign-off; Lucy = partner coordination. Rehearsal 2024-09-15.
Maria: I'll upload draft copy by 2024-08-20 and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
Concord PM: Sending logos and embargo confirmation now. Thanks everyone.
